title: CHARM: Calibrating Reward Models With Chatbot Arena Scores

live_model.evidence: Leaderboard listing: "gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 1256 55" among hundreds of Chatbot Arena models; the paper recalibrates existing Arena Elo scores rather than querying the models itself.

claim.metric: none (Arena Elo/scores are pre-existing crowdsourced data, not fresh model calls)

data.source: LMSYS Chatbot Arena leaderboard (public, but derived from human battles, not reproducible via simple prompting)

notes: CHARM's contribution is a statistical recalibration of already-collected Chatbot Arena human-preference scores; gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 appears only as one of hundreds of rows in that reused leaderboard data, not as a model the authors call themselves.
